notes.title: 关于重下游戏后无法点击开始游戏的问题解决方案。
notes.content:
[b]问题描述[/b]
此公告用于解决玩家在运行游戏后，点击开始游戏没有反应，存档没有内容的问题。

[b]解决方案[/b]
1.打开我的电脑，进入C盘以下路径：C:\Users\“你的用户名”\AppData\LocalLow\DefaultCompany。
在此文件夹中，可以看到名为“WayBackHome”的文件夹，将此文件夹删除。
2.下载网盘中的压缩包，链接：https://pan.baidu.com/s/1fEMYCN6c5K1wIDMNC3Hyeg?pwd=5zir   提取码5zir。（小文件，可以使用网页下载，不用网盘会员）
3.将此压缩包解压至步骤1的路径下。
4.打开游戏即可。
如果以上步骤无法解决问题，可以尝试验证完整性。

[b]后续计划[/b]

关于回门的后续更新计划，已经在近日开始实施，将一步步完善游戏中出现的各种问题，在此造成的各种困扰对大家说一声对不起，我们一定会努力修复的。

如果遇到无法解决的问题，可以加群反馈，群号：607180468

notes.title: 2021年2月6日更新说明。
notes.content:
对于上个版本给玩家造成的不良体验我们十分抱歉，非常对不起。
此次更新需要更新560M，对当前游戏内大量内容进行了优化，并修复了一些闪退问题及运行不稳定问题。本次更新不会覆盖游戏存档，敬请放心！

[b]以下是详细的更新说明：[/b]

1.修复了第一章病床刺绣一定触发条件下打不开的问题。
2.修复了第二章从陆爻切换到乔予安时切换地点错误的问题。
3.修复了第二章有时无法切换人物的问题。
4.修复了第二章切换角色之后台词一直重复的问题。
5.修复了第二章五子棋结束之后被拉回傀儡追逐战的问题。
6.修复了第二章五子棋偏移的问题。
7.修复了第二章五子棋对话内容重复的问题。
8.修复了第三章药房取药有时无法获得药包的问题。
9.修复了部分场景加载时重叠问题。

对于现版本不好的体验我们真的深感抱歉！我们仍旧在努力完善情节与优化游戏体验，《回门》还会继续更新与补充内容，感谢所有的鼓励与批评，我们会继续努力，为大家呈现出更好的游戏版本。
祝大家新年快乐，万事如意！

notes.title: Upcoming return 1.01 updates
notes.content:
Upcoming return 1.01 update:
After working overtime for a day and a night, we fixed the following issues:
1. Fixed an issue where the save was occasionally lost.
2. Reduce the chance of a flashback crash by reducing the image clarity of some maps and solving puzzles.
3. Added most of the map down ICONS.
4. Fixed mismatches between dialogue content and speech.
5. Fixed some scene BGM and sound effects not playing.
6. Fixed an issue where the resolution could not be adjusted.
7. Fixed an issue where Embroidery had a certain chance to quit and not re-enter.
8. Fixed an issue where crouching could not be done at too close distance.
9. Fixes an issue with dogs being small and large.
As well as the following is about the game content adjustment:
1. In the first chapter, reduce the movement speed of the ghost.
2. The first chapter reduces the embroidery play.
3. Removed the third timeline in the first chapter.
4. The second chapter can run all the way diagram.
5. The second chapter adds the map door sign.
6. Chapter 2 adds a reminder to switch roles.
7. The second chapter reduces the number of burning red lines.
8. Chapter 2 reduces the number of loops in the ghost corridor.
9. Chapter 2: Reduce the number of headless ghosts.
10. The second chapter reduces the difficulty of the lady picture and increases the clear hints.
11. In the second chapter, suggestions for Bagua matrix and puzzle solving process are added.
12. The second chapter adds a hint of chicken pecking rice clues page.
13. The second chapter abacus no longer considers gravity, restore the real abacus operation, and add clear prompts in the account book.
14. The second chapter enlarges the scope of use of the peach sword in porcelain vase.
15. Chapter 2 extends the burning time of the white lotus candle in the four corridors to infinity.
16. Added entry icon for puppet chase in chapter 2.
17. The second chapter adds the action tips after the completion of gobang.
18. The second chapter reduces the difficulty of marrying a ghost.
19. The third chapter reduces the difficulty of school bell ringing.
20. Chapter 3 Huarong Road can reduce the difficulty twice and increase the automatic saving.
21. Chapter 3 adds a hint for using toy frogs.
22. A section of the map was deleted in chapter IV.
We are very sorry for the bad game experience.
We hope the above update can help optimize the game flow and experience the story. We will actively adjust and modify the game to make it better.Sorry again for the current version of the existing problems, very sorry!
The new Meng team has a lot of shortcomings in terms of technology and experience, which need time to polish and modify. We have paid attention to everyone's suggestions and are working hard to repair them, hoping to bring better game experience to everyone.
About endings: The current version is a double ending, with trigger conditions depending on the options. If we can, we will add more endings in the future.
The interface song and the closing song will be unlocked together with OST later. Thank you for your love.
The production team of "Return Door" are all recent graduates, both in technology and production experience are not mature, thanks for all the encouragement and criticism, we will strive to grow and progress!
Wish you all a happy New Year and all the best
